items.title: Chapter 4: Money as a Social Technology
items.summary:
The medium of exchange: a quiet reminder of how we think and feel... 

Excerpt from Chapter 4:
"In a fiat system –by virtue of its intrinsic characteristics and what it stands for– suspicion can but arise. Thereafter, an ever-continuing sequence of seemingly random events can but serve to condone the philosophical-political principle according to which “the end justifies the means”, rendering the prevailing monetary system utterly consistent. With sound money also, incentives can change, yet the interaction itself remains unaffected, because the medium of exchange has become neutral again. A change from fiat to sound money, then, reflects a dawning sense of value—or one that is already present."
As Bitcoiners, we cannot afford to carry fiat habits into a sound money paradigm, lest we taint even our noblest efforts with compromised means. Treat every transaction as a deliberate choice to uphold neutrality, vigilance, and what is truly at stake.
